expects.query:
Using the `vss-build-vision-agent` skill's model-routing overlay, compose a build on the `lvs` Foundation into `_builds/routing-check/` that sends the agent's LLM traffic to a model router reachable at `http://10.0.0.5:4000` instead of the in-cluster NIM. Do NOT deploy it, do not start any container, and do not pull any image. Run autonomously.

**Environment & prerequisites:** the repository checkout is at `{{repo_root}}`; work from there. Export `VSS_APPS_DIR={{repo_root}}/deploy/docker` before composing. Routing is a configuration of an endpoint VSS already supports, so nothing needs to be installed and no router needs to be running for this composition check. (See `skills/vss-build-vision-agent/references/services/model-routing.md`.)
checks: The build artifacts exist: `test -f {{repo_root}}/_builds/routing-check/override.env` and `test -f {{repo_root}}/_builds/routing-check/compose.yml` and `test -f {{repo_root}}/_builds/routing-check/resolved.yml` each return exit 0.

**Routing ADDS no service.** Diffing the Foundation's `docker compose --env-file {{repo_root}}/deploy/docker/developer-profiles/dev-profile-lvs/overrides.env -f {{repo_root}}/deploy/docker/compose.yml config --services | sort` against the build's `docker compose --env-file .../override.env -f .../compose.yml config --services | sort` produces **no `>` line at all**. A build that adds any service key to enable routing fails this check, which is the central contract of the model-routing overlay. **Removals are expected and must not fail this check:** `COMPOSE_PROFILES` carries the dynamic key `llm_${LLM_MODE}_${LLM_NAME_SLUG}`, so switching to remote resolves the local LLM NIM services away (on `lvs`, the two `nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b*` entries). That is correct behaviour and part of the point, since the GPU those services held is freed.
`_builds/routing-check/override.env` sets `LLM_MODE=remote` and `LLM_NAME_SLUG=none`, matching the Remote LLM override set in references/env-overrides.md.

`_builds/routing-check/override.env` sets `LLM_BASE_URL` to the router at `http://10.0.0.5:4000`, and its value does **not** end in `/v1`. The agent appends `/v1` itself, so a trailing `/v1` here produces requests to `.../v1/v1/...` and is a failure even though it looks plausible.

The composed `COMPOSE_PROFILES` in `_builds/routing-check/override.env` is unchanged from the Foundation's `COMPOSE_PROFILES` in `{{repo_root}}/deploy/docker/developer-profiles/dev-profile-lvs/overrides.env`: same keys, no additions, no removals.
`docker compose --env-file {{repo_root}}/_builds/routing-check/override.env -f {{repo_root}}/_builds/routing-check/compose.yml config --quiet` returns exit 0 — the build parses as valid Compose.

`git -C {{repo_root}} status --porcelain deploy/docker/developer-profiles/dev-profile-lvs/overrides.env` produces no output: the Foundation's checked-in overrides.env was not edited. Routing must be configured in the build copy, never in the profile, since editing the profile changes it for every later build. Report the full output of `git -C {{repo_root}} status --porcelain deploy/docker` verbatim as context, but judge only the overrides.env result — the harness does not reset the checkout between trials, so unrelated residue may be present.
`git -C {{repo_root}} status --porcelain skills | wc -l` outputs 0 (no skill file was modified).
`docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | wc -l` shows no container was started by this task, and the trajectory contains no `docker compose up`, `docker run`, or `docker pull`.
